# Synthetic conflict-campaign parser input

This fixture exercises the current legacy parser's 24 deterministic paired
cells plus 22 paired seed expansions (68 total), malformed input checks and
metric admission. All cell identities and values are synthetic. The campaign
runner explicitly rejects this fixture before creating output or launching roles.

The original v2 campaign definition is unavailable. The retained integration182
checkout instead contains a later v1, sixteen-cell redesign whose plan explicitly
withdraws the centralized comparison. It is incompatible and must not be renamed
to pretend to recover v2. These tests do not qualify that withdrawn experiment.
The legacy runner requires explicit original manifest and prior evidence paths;
ordinary source/installed CPU inference uses the maintained native deployment owner.
